title: Prior-only adjacent-run-count transition diagnostic
hypothesis: The number of adjacent integer pairs in the immediately preceding draw may add one-step information about the adjacent-pair count in the next draw beyond the exact combinatorial marginal and a prior-only unconditional empirical marginal.

statistic.name: A_t
statistic.definition: For sorted draw x1<x2<x3<x4<x5, A_t = sum(i=1..4) 1[x_(i+1)-x_i=1].
statistic.interpretation: A_t equals five minus the number of consecutive runs in the selected 5-subset.

exact_null.name: Uniform 5-of-40 subset law
exact_null.derivation: Choose a of the four internal adjacency links to join the five selected values into 5-a runs, then place those runs among 40 positions with at least one unused position between runs.

models.M1: Prior-only unconditional prequential PMF: (200*q0[a] + prior_count[a])/(200 + prior_n).
models.M2: Prior-only one-step transition PMF conditioned on A_(t-1): (200*M1_t[a] + prior_transition_count[state,a])/(200 + prior_state_count[state]).

protocol.target_rule: For target draw t (zero-based), calculate A_t only after scoring. M1 may use A_0..A_(t-1). M2 may use transition pairs (A_(j-1),A_j) only for 1<=j<=t-1, conditioned on state A_(t-1).
protocol.scoring_order: Score target t before updating any count with A_t.
protocol.tuning: No parameter tuning, state merging, bin search, or subgroup search.

inference.alternative: Positive gain means the candidate has lower loss; one-sided randomization test for positive gain.
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across six preregistered Blind OOS endpoints.

limitations: Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout.
Holm correction is local to the six Q128 endpoints and does not correct the entire Q00-Q128 research family.
The statistic compresses each draw to one run-count value and is not a full quintet predictor.

next_action: After the official publication of contest 315, append the verified outcome and score only immutable existing freezes; continue Q60 append-only paired collection.
